desc: Engineered for concealed carry with uncompromising performance, the Tisas PX-9 Carry Raptor Comp in 9mm delivers top-tier features in a compact, duty-ready package. Built on a durable polymer frame and finished in a sleek black, this pistol is equipped with a 3.5" barrel and integrated compensator for reduced muzzle flip and faster follow-up shots. Whether you're hitting the range or carrying daily, the adjustable fiber optic front sight and serrated rear sight provide a crisp, quick sight picture. The RMR-cut slide makes it optics-ready right out of the box, while interchangeable grip panels let you customize the fit for ultimate control.
